title: First Day Hustle
text: Welcome to your room in Udu. Your pocket dey light (₦5,000) and rent is coming at end of month. Time to hit the street and start the hustle.

success.text: You tie your shoe laces and head out into the morning sunshine.

choices.label: Sit down and plan your budget

success.text: You write down your goals inside notebook. Discipline is key.

title: Keke Fare Wahala
text: The keke rider shouts say fuel price increase today, so fare is now double (₦600). You know say na wash.

success.text: You give am sweet talk. 'Oga driver, na my area!'. He laughs and collects normal ₦300.

fail.text: He no gree. Other passengers rush enter. You pay extra ₦200.

success.text: You pay peace of mind money. No time for altercation.
Loud noise at junction! People gathered to watch drama. You stood on principle.

title: Light Don Go
text: NEPA take light, and your phone battery dey blinking at 4%. You have an urgent gig client inquiry waiting.

success.text: Phone charged to 70% inside charging booth. Saved the gig!

choices.label: Let the phone die and rest

success.text: Phone off. Quiet night, but missed the client message.

title: Aso-Ebi Pressure
text: Ejiro pulls you aside: 'My guy, wedding dey this Saturday! The fabric na ₦4,000, we must uniform fine fine!'

success.text: You show up looking like a real Delta boss. Owambe groove was legendary!
Tailor makes custom cap and muffler for ₦2,000. Style still loud!

fail.text: Tailor refused. You bought pocket handkerchief for ₦500.

success.text: Ejiro understands: 'No wahala my guy, next time!'

title: Market Day Test
text: Major market day! Bulk shipments arrived at the water-side jetty. Big opportunity to buy wholesale and flip.

success.text: Sold out all pairs by midday! Made ₦6,500 total.

fail.text: Rain fell in afternoon. Sold only few pairs, broke even.

choices.label: Help wholesalers offload cartons for daily wage

success.text: Heavy lifting, honest cash. Cash in hand ₦2,500.

title: Rent a Market Table (Chapter 1 Finale)
text: Elder Mine calls you to the market union office: 'Young hustle, I have observed your consistency. A prime table near Section A is vacant for lease.'

choices.label: Pay ₦12,000 Lease Deposit & Sign Union Register

success.text: CHAMPION! You are officially a registered business merchant at Warri Main Market. Chapter 1 Completed!

choices.label: Ask for more time to gather capital

success.text: Elder Mine nods: 'Come back when your pocket is fully ready.'
